{{Quote|Building's damp, but safe enough.|Zenith|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
During the occupation of [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] revolutionary [[Zenith]] possessed a '''safe house''' in the settlement of [[Bugtown]]. It later became the base of operations for the [[Balmorran resistance]] during [[trade secretary]] [[Tai Cordan]]'s [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|campaign]] to liberate the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].
